const NAME=r"^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,19}$"
const ROLE=r"^[a-z]{1,16}$"
const MEDIA=r"^[a-z0-9.+-]+/[a-z0-9.+-]+$"
const UNRESERVED="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-._~"
const REASONS=Dict(
    200=>"OK",
    204=>"No Content",
    301=>"Moved Permanently",
    302=>"Found",
    304=>"Not Modified",
    307=>"Temporary Redirect",
    308=>"Permanent Redirect",
    400=>"Bad Request",
    401=>"Unauthorized",
    403=>"Forbidden",
    404=>"Not Found",
    405=>"Method Not Allowed",
    406=>"Not Acceptable",
    412=>"Precondition Failed",
    429=>"Too Many Requests",
    501=>"Not Implemented",
)
const HEADERORDER=split(
    "Location Allow Retry-After WWW-Authenticate Access-Control-Allow-Origin Access-Control-Allow-Methods Vary ETag Content-Type Content-Length",
)
struct InputError <: Exception
    message::String
end
fail(s) = throw(InputError(s))
part(s, a, b = length(s)) = a>b ? "" : String(s[a:b])
trim(s) = String(strip(s, ' '))
function partition(s, separator)
    p=findfirst(separator, s)
    p===nothing ? (String(s), false, "") : (part(s, 1, first(p)-1), true, part(s, last(p)+1))
end
segment(s) = !isempty(s) && all(c->c in UNRESERVED, s) && !(s in (".", ".."))
canonical(s) =
    s=="/" || startswith(s, "/") && all(segment, split(part(s, 2), '/'; keepempty = true))
decimal(s, lo, hi) = occursin(r"^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$", s) && lo<=parse(BigInt, s)<=hi
decode(s) = replace(s, r"%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}"=>x->string(Char(parse(Int, part(x, 2); base = 16))))
encode(s) =
    join(c in UNRESERVED ? string(c) : "%"*uppercase(string(Int(c); base = 16, pad = 2)) for c in s)
encoded(pairs) = join((encode(k)*"="*encode(v) for (k, v) in pairs), "&")
withhead(methods) = "GET" in methods ? union(Set(methods), Set(["HEAD"])) : Set(methods)
struct Piece
    kind::Symbol
    name::String
end
function pattern(s)
    startswith(s, "/") || return nothing
    s=="/" && return Piece[]
    pieces=Piece[]
    names=Set{String}()
    fields=split(part(s, 2), '/'; keepempty = true)
    for (i, field) in enumerate(fields)
        if segment(field)
            push!(pieces, Piece(:literal, field))
            continue
        end
        m=match(r"^\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,19})(?::(int|slug))?\}$", field)
        w=match(r"^\{\*([a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,19})\}$", field)
        if w!==nothing && i==length(fields)
            k=:wildcard
            name=String(w.captures[1])
        elseif m!==nothing
            k=m.captures[2]===nothing ? :untyped : Symbol(m.captures[2])
            name=String(m.captures[1])
        else
            return nothing
        end
        name in names && return nothing
        push!(names, name)
        push!(pieces, Piece(k, name))
    end
    pieces
end
fits(p, s) =
    p.kind==:literal ? s==p.name :
    p.kind==:int ? occursin(r"^[0-9]{1,9}$", s) :
    p.kind==:slug ? occursin(r"^[a-z0-9-]+$", s) : true
accepts(p, s) =
    p.kind==:untyped ? !(s in ("", ".", "..")) :
    p.kind==:wildcard ?
    isempty(s) || all(x->!(x in ("", ".", "..")), split(s, '/'; keepempty = true)) : fits(p, s)
mutable struct Route
    name::String
    methods::Set{String}
    pattern::String
    pieces::Vector{Piece}
    role::String
    number::Int
    types::Vector{String}
    selections::Int
end
wild(r) = !isempty(r.pieces) && last(r.pieces).kind==:wildcard
priority(r) = (
    -count(p->p.kind==:literal, r.pieces),
    -count(p->p.kind in (:int, :slug), r.pieces),
    wild(r),
    r.number,
)
function matches(r, segments)
    n=length(r.pieces)-wild(r)
    length(segments)>=n &&
        (wild(r) || length(segments)==n) &&
        all(i->fits(r.pieces[i], segments[i]), 1:n)
end
function rulepath(s)
    if endswith(s, "/*")
        base=part(s, 1, length(s)-2)
        return base!="/" && canonical(base) ? (base, true) : nothing
    end
    canonical(s) ? (String(s), false) : nothing
end
mutable struct Response
    status::Int
    body::Union{Nothing,String}
    headers::Dict{String,String}
    type::String
end
Response(status, body = nothing, headers = Dict{String,String}(), type = "text/plain") =
    Response(status, body, headers, type)
redirect(code, destination) =
    Response(code, "redirect to $destination", Dict("Location"=>destination))
mutable struct Client
    level::Int
    time::Int
    allowed::Int
    limited::Int
end
mutable struct Router
    routes::Vector{Route}
    ranked::Vector{Route}
    tokens::Dict{String,String}
    redirects::Vector{Tuple{String,String,Bool,String,Int}}
    origins::Set{String}
    capacity::Int
    period::Int
    errors::Int
    requests::Int
    urlok::Int
    urlerror::Int
    statuses::Dict{Int,Int}
    clients::Dict{String,Client}
end
Router() = Router(
    Route[],
    Route[],
    Dict{String,String}(),
    Tuple{String,String,Bool,String,Int}[],
    Set{String}(),
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    Dict{Int,Int}(),
    Dict{String,Client}(),
)
findroute(r, name) = findfirst(x->x.name==name, r.routes)
function configure!(r, line)
    words=String.(split(line, ' '))
    cmd=words[1]
    a=words[2:end]
    n=length(a)
    cmd in ("ROUTE", "TOKEN", "REDIRECT", "ORIGIN", "LIMIT", "TYPES") ||
        fail("unknown command $cmd")
    valid=cmd=="ROUTE" ? n in (3, 5) :
          cmd=="TOKEN" ? n==2 :
          cmd=="REDIRECT" ? n==3 : cmd=="ORIGIN" ? n==1 : cmd=="LIMIT" ? n==2 : n>=2
    valid || fail("wrong number of arguments")
    if cmd=="ROUTE"
        name, methods, word=a[1:3]
        occursin(NAME, name) || fail("bad route name $name")
        findroute(r, name)!==nothing && fail("duplicate route $name")
        ms=String.(split(methods, ','; keepempty = true))
        all(m->m in ("GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE"), ms) &&
        length(unique(ms))==length(ms) || fail("bad methods $methods")
        pieces=pattern(word)
        pieces===nothing && fail("bad pattern $word")
        role="none"
        if n==5
            a[4]=="ROLE" || fail("unknown option $(a[4])")
            occursin(ROLE, a[5]) || fail("bad role $(a[5])")
            role=a[5]
        end
        push!(r.routes, Route(name, Set(ms), word, pieces, role, length(r.routes)+1, String[], 0))
    elseif cmd=="TOKEN"
        token, role=a
        occursin(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}$", token) || fail("bad token $token")
        haskey(r.tokens, token) && fail("duplicate token $token")
        occursin(ROLE, role) || fail("bad role $role")
        r.tokens[token]=role
    elseif cmd=="REDIRECT"
        from, to, code=a
        src=rulepath(from)
        src===nothing && fail("bad path $from")
        dst=rulepath(to)
        dst===nothing && fail("bad path $to")
        src[2]==dst[2] || fail("wildcard mismatch")
        code in ("301", "302", "307", "308") || fail("bad redirect code $code")
        any(x->x[1]==from, r.redirects) && fail("duplicate redirect $from")
        push!(r.redirects, (from, src[1], src[2], dst[1], parse(Int, code)))
    elseif cmd=="ORIGIN"
        s=a[1]
        occursin(r"^https?://[a-z0-9.:-]+$", s) || fail("bad origin $s")
        s in r.origins && fail("duplicate origin $s")
        push!(r.origins, s)
    elseif cmd=="LIMIT"
        decimal(a[1], 1, 100) && decimal(a[2], 1, 3600) || fail("bad limit")
        r.capacity>0 && fail("duplicate limit")
        r.capacity=parse(Int, a[1])
        r.period=parse(Int, a[2])
    else
        name=a[1]
        idx=findroute(r, name)
        idx===nothing && fail("unknown route $name")
        route=r.routes[idx]
        !isempty(route.types) && fail("duplicate types $name")
        seen=Set{String}()
        for t in a[2:end]
            occursin(MEDIA, t) || fail("bad media type $t")
            t in seen && fail("duplicate media type $t")
            push!(seen, t)
        end
        route.types=a[2:end]
    end
end
function finish!(r)
    limit=r.capacity==0 ? "none" : "$(r.capacity)/$(r.period)"
    println(
        "CONFIG routes=$(length(r.routes)) tokens=$(length(r.tokens)) redirects=$(length(r.redirects)) origins=$(length(r.origins)) limit=$limit errors=$(r.errors)",
    )
    for route in r.routes
        isempty(route.types) && push!(route.types, "application/json")
    end
    r.ranked=sort(r.routes; by = priority)
    for (i, route) in enumerate(r.ranked)
        println(
            "TABLE $i $(route.name) $(join(sort!(collect(withhead(route.methods))),',')) $(route.pattern) role=$(route.role=="none" ? "-" : route.role) types=$(join(route.types,','))",
        )
    end
end
function normalized(path)
    escaped=replace(path, r"%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}"=>s->begin
        c=Char(parse(Int, part(s, 2); base = 16))
        c in UNRESERVED ? string(c) : uppercase(s)
    end)
    pieces=String[]
    for s in split(part(escaped, 2), '/'; keepempty = true)
        if s==".."
            !isempty(pieces) && pop!(pieces)
        elseif !(s in ("", "."))
            push!(pieces, s)
        end
    end
    "/"*join(pieces, '/')
end
function negotiate(types, accept)
    accept===nothing && return types[1]
    elements=Tuple{String,Int,Int}[]
    for raw in split(accept, ','; keepempty = true)
        parts=trim.(split(raw, ';'; keepempty = true))
        range=lowercase(parts[1])
        specificity=range=="*/*" ? 1 :
                    occursin(r"^[a-z0-9.+-]+/\*$", range) ? 2 : occursin(MEDIA, range) ? 3 : 0
        weight=1000
        for parameter in parts[2:end]
            key, equal, v=partition(parameter, "=")
            if equal && lowercase(trim(key))=="q"
                v=trim(v)
                if !occursin(r"^(?:0(?:\.[0-9]{0,3})?|1(?:\.0{0,3})?)$", v)
                    weight=-1
                else
                    whole, _, fraction=partition(v, ".")
                    weight=1000*parse(Int, whole)+parse(Int, rpad(fraction, 3, '0'))
                end
                break
            end
        end
        specificity>0 && weight>=0 && push!(elements, (range, specificity, weight))
    end
    best=nothing
    bestweight=0
    for type in types
        specificity=0
        weight=0
        for (range, rank, w) in elements
            fits=range=="*/*" ||
                 endswith(range, "/*") && startswith(type, part(range, 1, length(range)-1)) ||
                 range==type
            if fits && rank>specificity
                specificity=rank
                weight=w
            end
        end
        if weight>bestweight
            best=type
            bestweight=weight
        end
    end
    best
end
jsonstring(s) = "\""*replace(s, '\\'=>"\\\\", '"'=>"\\\"")*"\""
jsonobject(pairs) = "{"*join((jsonstring(k)*":"*jsonstring(v) for (k, v) in pairs), ',')*"}"
html(s) = replace(s, '&'=>"&", '<'=>"<", '>'=>">", '"'=>""")
function body(type, name, params, query, cookies)
    if type=="application/json"
        q=join(("["*jsonstring(k)*","*jsonstring(v)*"]" for (k, v) in query), ',')
        return "{\"route\":"*jsonstring(name)*",\"params\":"*jsonobject(params)*",\"query\":["*q*"],\"cookies\":"*jsonobject(
            cookies,
        )*"}"
    elseif type=="text/html"
        entries=[("route", name)]
        for (prefix, pairs) in (("param", params), ("query", query), ("cookie", cookies))
            append!(entries, [(prefix*" "*k, v) for (k, v) in pairs])
        end
        return "<dl>"*join("<dt>$(html(k))</dt><dd>$(html(v))</dd>" for (k, v) in entries)*"</dl>"
    end
    lists=[isempty(pairs) ? "-" : encoded(pairs) for pairs in (params, query, cookies)]
    "route=$name params=$(lists[1]) query=$(lists[2]) cookies=$(lists[3])"
end
function etag(s)
    a=1
    b=0
    for c in s
        a=mod(a+Int(c), 65521)
        b=mod(b+a, 65521)
    end
    "\""*string(b; base = 16, pad = 4)*string(a; base = 16, pad = 4)*"\""
end
function route_request!(r, method, path, query, h)
    segments=path=="/" ? String[] : String.(split(part(path, 2), '/'))
    matching=filter(route->matches(route, segments), r.ranked)
    isempty(matching) && return Response(404, "not found: $path")
    allowed=Set(["OPTIONS"])
    for route in matching
        union!(allowed, route.methods)
    end
    allow=join(sort!(collect(withhead(allowed))), ", ")
    method=="OPTIONS" && return Response(204, nothing, Dict("Allow"=>allow))
    lookup=method=="HEAD" ? "GET" : method
    idx=findfirst(route->lookup in route.methods, matching)
    idx===nothing && return Response(405, "method not allowed: $method", Dict("Allow"=>allow))
    route=matching[idx]
    route.selections+=1
    if route.role!="none"
        !haskey(h, "authorization") && return Response(
            401,
            "unauthorized: missing token",
            Dict("WWW-Authenticate"=>"Bearer realm=\"api\""),
        )
        scheme, _, token=partition(h["authorization"], " ")
        (lowercase(scheme)!="bearer" || !haskey(r.tokens, token)) && return Response(
            401,
            "unauthorized: invalid token",
            Dict("WWW-Authenticate"=>"Bearer realm=\"api\", error=\"invalid_token\""),
        )
        r.tokens[token] in (route.role, "admin") ||
            return Response(403, "forbidden: requires role $(route.role)")
    end
    vary=length(route.types)>1 ? Dict("Vary"=>"Accept") : Dict{String,String}()
    type=negotiate(route.types, get(h, "accept", nothing))
    type===nothing && return Response(406, "not acceptable: $(join(route.types,", "))", vary)
    params=Tuple{String,String}[]
    for (i, p) in enumerate(route.pieces)
        p.kind==:literal && continue
        v=p.kind==:wildcard ? join(decode.(segments[i:end]), '/') :
          p.kind==:int ? string(parse(Int, segments[i])) :
          p.kind==:untyped ? decode(segments[i]) : segments[i]
        push!(params, (p.name, v))
    end
    sort!(params; by = first)
    queries=Tuple{String,String}[]
    if query!==nothing
        for raw in split(query, '&'; keepempty = true)
            isempty(raw) && continue
            k, _, v=partition(raw, "=")
            push!(queries, (decode(replace(k, '+'=>' ')), decode(replace(v, '+'=>' '))))
        end
    end
    cookies=Dict{String,String}()
    for raw in split(get(h, "cookie", ""), ';'; keepempty = true)
        k, equal, v=partition(trim(raw), "=")
        equal && !isempty(k) && !haskey(cookies, k) && (cookies[k]=v)
    end
    result=body(type, route.name, params, queries, sort!(collect(cookies); by = first))
    tag=etag(result)
    if haskey(h, "if-none-match")
        hit=any(
            raw->begin
                x=trim(raw)
                startswith(x, "W/") && (x=part(x, 3))
                x in ("*", tag)
            end,
            split(h["if-none-match"], ','; keepempty = true),
        )
        if hit
            if lookup=="GET"
                vary["ETag"]=tag
                return Response(304, nothing, vary)
            else
                return Response(412, "precondition failed: $tag", vary)
            end
        end
    end
    vary["ETag"]=tag
    Response(200, result, vary, type)
end
function dispatch!(r, method, target, h)
    method in ("GET", "HEAD", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS") ||
        return Response(501, "not implemented: $method")
    isempty(get(h, "host", "")) && return Response(400, "bad request: missing host")
    effective=method
    if haskey(h, "x-http-method-override")
        override=h["x-http-method-override"]
        method=="POST" && override in ("PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE") ||
            return Response(400, "bad request: method override")
        effective=override
    end
    client=get(h, "x-client", "")
    if !isempty(client)
        time=parse(Int, h["x-time"])
        c=get!(r.clients, client, Client(r.capacity*r.period, time, 0, 0))
        wait=0
        if r.capacity>0
            c.level=min(r.capacity*r.period, c.level+(time-c.time)*r.capacity)
            c.time=time
            if c.level<r.period
                wait=cld(r.period-c.level, r.capacity)
            else
                c.level-=r.period
            end
        end
        if wait>0
            c.limited+=1
            return Response(
                429,
                "too many requests: client $client",
                Dict("Retry-After"=>string(wait)),
            )
        end
        c.allowed+=1
    end
    path, question, query=partition(target, "?")
    suffix=question ? "?"*query : ""
    normal=normalized(path)
    normal!=path && return redirect(308, normal*suffix)
    for (_, base, prefix, to, code) in r.redirects
        (path==base || prefix && startswith(path, base*"/")) &&
            return redirect(code, to*part(path, length(base)+1)*suffix)
    end
    route_request!(r, effective, path, question ? query : nothing, h)
end
function respond!(r, line, headers)
    fields=String.(split(line, ' '; keepempty = true))
    valid=length(fields)==3 &&
          occursin(r"^[A-Z]{1,16}$", fields[1]) &&
          startswith(fields[2], "/") &&
          !occursin('#', fields[2]) &&
          fields[3]=="HTTP/1.1"
    valid || return Response(400, "bad request: request line"), true
    method, target, _=fields
    showbody=method!="HEAD"
    for i in eachindex(target)
        if target[i]=='%'
            raw=part(target, i+1, min(i+2, length(target)))
            occursin(r"^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$", raw) && 32<=parse(Int, raw; base = 16)<=126 ||
                return Response(400, "bad request: percent escape"), showbody
        end
    end
    h=Dict{String,String}()
    for (i, header) in enumerate(headers)
        name, colon, v=partition(header, ":")
        colon && occursin(r"^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$", name) ||
            return Response(400, "bad request: header line $i"), showbody
        name=lowercase(name)
        haskey(h, name) && return Response(400, "bad request: duplicate header $name"), showbody
        h[name]=trim(v)
    end
    response=dispatch!(r, method, target, h)
    origin=get(h, "origin", nothing)
    if origin in r.origins
        response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Origin"]=origin
        response.status==204 &&
            haskey(h, "access-control-request-method") &&
            (response.headers["Access-Control-Allow-Methods"]=response.headers["Allow"])
    end
    response, showbody
end
function urlfor(r, name, args)
    idx=findroute(r, name)
    idx===nothing && fail("unknown route $name")
    route=r.routes[idx]
    names=Set(p.name for p in route.pieces if p.kind!=:literal)
    values=Dict{String,String}()
    query=Tuple{String,String}[]
    for arg in args
        k, equal, v=partition(arg, "=")
        equal && !isempty(k) || fail("bad argument $arg")
        if k in names
            haskey(values, k) && fail("duplicate parameter $k")
            values[k]=v
        else
            push!(query, (k, v))
        end
    end
    segments=String[]
    for p in route.pieces
        if p.kind==:literal
            push!(segments, p.name)
            continue
        end
        v=get(values, p.name, nothing)
        v===nothing && p.kind!=:wildcard && fail("missing parameter $(p.name)")
        v!==nothing && !accepts(p, v) && fail("bad value for $(p.name)")
        if p.kind!=:wildcard
            push!(segments, encode(v))
        elseif v!==nothing && !isempty(v)
            append!(segments, encode.(split(v, '/')))
        end
    end
    "/"*join(segments, '/')*(isempty(query) ? "" : "?"*encoded(query))
end
function main()
    lines=readlines()
    r=Router()
    at=1
    while lines[at]!="REQUESTS"
        try
            configure!(r, lines[at])
        catch e
            e isa InputError || rethrow()
            r.errors+=1
            println("CONFIG ERROR $at: $(e.message)")
        end
        at+=1
    end
    finish!(r)
    at+=1
    while lines[at]!="END"
        if startswith(lines[at], "URLFOR ")
            fields=String.(split(lines[at], ' '))
            name=fields[2]
            try
                url=urlfor(r, name, fields[3:end])
                r.urlok+=1
                println("URLFOR $name $url")
            catch e
                e isa InputError || rethrow()
                r.urlerror+=1
                println("URLFOR ERROR $(e.message)")
            end
            at+=1
        else
            line=lines[at]
            at+=1
            headers=String[]
            while !isempty(lines[at])
                push!(headers, lines[at])
                at+=1
            end
            at+=1
            response, showbody=respond!(r, line, headers)
            r.requests+=1
            status=response.status
            r.statuses[status]=get(r.statuses, status, 0)+1
            println("REQUEST $(r.requests)\nHTTP/1.1 $status $(REASONS[status])")
            if response.body!==nothing
                response.headers["Content-Type"]=response.type
                response.headers["Content-Length"]=string(length(response.body))
            end
            for name in HEADERORDER
                haskey(response.headers, name) && println("$name: $(response.headers[name])")
            end
            response.body!==nothing && showbody && println(response.body)
        end
    end
    println("SUMMARY requests=$(r.requests) urlfor_ok=$(r.urlok) urlfor_error=$(r.urlerror)")
    for status in sort!(collect(keys(r.statuses)))
        println("STATUS $status $(r.statuses[status])")
    end
    for route in r.routes
        println("ROUTE $(route.name) $(route.selections)")
    end
    for name in sort!(collect(keys(r.clients)))
        c=r.clients[name]
        println("CLIENT $name allowed=$(c.allowed) limited=$(c.limited)")
    end
end
main()
